verdict.rationale: ReelMimic documents that the whole thing runs on your own computer with your own Claude Code or Codex, so project data is stored wherever you choose to run it. That local-first design gives you de facto control over residency. It is not a documented storage-location or region setting, though, and the pack never says where the AI backends or optional TTS services (Yating, ElevenLabs) process or keep data. Missing for 10: an explicit storage-location or region choice, documentation of where data goes when sent to Claude Code, Codex or TTS providers, and independent corroboration.
